title: Josh
desc: Set in Vasco, Goa, Max and Prakash are young men who lead two rival groups. Their feud becomes worse when Prakash's brother, Rahul, falls in love with Shirley, Max's twin sister.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Kasam Hindustan Ki
desc: Dhuruvan is a forest ranger who trains NCC cadets. On a trek with five college girls, he stumbles upon a gang of terrorists who plan to foil a rocket launch by ISRO.

title: International Khiladi
desc: An international crime boss and his journalist girlfriend fall victim to an elaborate conspiracy that claims an innocent life and turns them into bitter enemies.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.
